wiki.title: Carlos A. Giménez
wiki.extract: Carlos Antonio Giménez ( hee-MEH-nez; born January 17, 1954) is a Cuban-born American politician and retired firefighter serving in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2021. He has represented Florida's 28th congressional district since 2023, previously representing the 26th district in his first term. He is a member of the Republican Party.
